profile.headline: Software Engineer at Citizens
profile.summary: Software engineer. Enhancing Citizens’ services and platforms using modern solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer building Open Banking APIs at Citizens. 

- Implemented core API functionality to serve Citizens commercial customers' financial data securely to their Fintech apps.
- Implemented a bot protection security enhancement to protect login endpoints from bot attacks. Drove the delivery of the feature from start to finish - implemented the integration in the Angular project, supported QA testing efforts, coordinated with other cross-functional teams, released the feature to production, and ensured monitoring and alerting covered potential issues. 
- Took on the role of production release specialist, serving as the dedicated resource to execute production deployments. Completed dozens of successful releases, facilitated many clean back-outs, and have since trained new engineers on the process. 
- Worked on a new operations-focused team within the Open Banking ecosystem, responsible for maintaining high availability and uptime as production traffic quickly scaled, from zero to millions of API calls per day. Created and enhanced Datadog dashboards, worked with the bank's change management teams to refine production release practices, and implemented robust monitoring/alerting mechanisms.
- Interfaced with 6+ third-party tech partners on a daily basis to drive both a positive working relationship and end-user satisfaction by discussing customer issues, potential system enhancements, and upcoming changes.

positions.title: ETSDP Associate
positions.description:
Associate in the Enterprise Technology and Security Development Program (ETSDP) at Citizens. Worked on three different teams over nine months, gaining broad perspective on the bank's tech ecosystem and applied experience on three different projects.

1. Architecture and Innovation 
- Worked with an Enterprise Architect at the bank, focused on proof-of-concept work surrounding AI adoption and productivity measurement options. Gained strategic perspective on the decision-making process behind adopting new tools at a large company, and gained experience using cutting-edge code-assist tools.
- Supported an AWS VPC reserved for innovation/proof-of-concept work. 
2. Platform Team
- Helped maintain code and configurations (standard Helm charts, Groovy pipelines, base Docker images) used across hundreds of projects.
- Presented to the team a new type of base Docker image, now adopted by dozens of teams at the bank, improving simplicity of Dockerfiles and reducing resource utilization.
3. Open Banking
- Developed across the full stack of the Open Banking project (Angular, Node, Java (Spring Boot), Postgres), resolving defects and raising unit test code coverage to 80+% across multiple repositories
- Implemented a mock banking data framework (using Express.js and Postgres) capable of emulating thousands of bank accounts and transactions, accelerating testing cycles and enabling testing of high-volume test cases.
positions.insights: Platform as a Service (PAAS), Java and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built an AI-powered pipeline that generates trending news stories, based on aggregated news data from hundreds of news sites.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and delivered several enhancements to a hardware emulator used for software and systems testing.
- Deployed test software to a dedicated Windows server hosted on an AWS virtual machine, allowing for more efficient use of hardware resources during the testing process.
- Gained experience with SNMP, Java development (REST services), networking (CIDR, subnetting, IP aliasing), and virtual machine management.

- Worked on fundraising efforts and team-building events within the club

organizations.name: UConn Honors Program
organizations.description: As a member of UConn's Honors program, I am eligible to enroll in Honors core courses, convert regular courses to Honors credit, and apply early for housing and class enrollment, as well as take part in the many different Honors groups and events on campus. To remain in the Honors program, one must maintain at least a 3.4 cumulative GPA, and take 6 credits' worth of Honors courses/conversions each academic year.
